title: users.email_verified
description: EmailVerified is published by identify once, when the user confirms the email of an account created with email sign-up (OAuth sign-ups never publish it: they are already verified in AccountRegistered). Like AccountRegistered it only exists for admin's back-office listing, which shows unverified accounts as pending. Verification is never undone, so there is no version: a repeated or out-of-order delivery is harmless, and it may arrive before AccountRegistered.

event_id.description: Identificador único del evento. Usar para deduplicar (at-least-once).

occurred_at.description: Momento del hecho de negocio, ISO 8601 en UTC.

verified_at.description: Momento en que se confirmó el email, ISO 8601 en UTC.
